gaps: a scale of 0 or below leaves X_ITE 16.6.0 with 0 segments (NaN vertices); here the surface keeps one cell

the set draws nothing itself in either engine: the surfaces are drawn by the Shapes that hold them; bboxSize / bboxCenter / bboxDisplay / visible are kept as field values and do not move anything (X_ITE 16.6.0 uses the bbox of the surfaces for culling only)
NurbsTrimmedSurface (a later batch) joins the set the same way (the scale code names it already)
scope: the triangle count of each surface, from the vertices X_ITE builds (getVertices) and from the mesh this reader builds, after each change
